title: Apple HIG is a guideline source, applied as pages are redesigned
context: Control sizes and contrast were chosen page by page, with no external guideline to settle disagreements.
decision: Apple HIG is adopted as a guideline source for the app's design and applied gradually, as each page is redesigned, not in one sweep.

alternatives.option: Apply HIG to every page at once
alternatives.reason: A sweeping redesign with no per-page review.
Nothing settles a disagreement about size, contrast or motion.

consequences: HIG rules reach a page only when that page is redesigned, so the app stays mixed for a while.
revisitTriggers: HIG adoption proves too broad to apply page by page.
